summary: Fusemachines Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, reporting a September 10, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with certain vendors and service providers. The company will issue up to 2,138,935 unregistered common shares at $0.6103 per share, the five-day VWAP, to satisfy approximately $1.30 million in accrued unpaid fees. No cash was received; issuance is expected on or about September 14, 2026, under Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b). The company agreed to file a resale registration statement within 90 days. This is a routine vendor-share settlement, not a special situation; watch resale registration timing and potential selling pressure.
